g.text: Do document-rediscovery probes track task utility?
Exploratory lexical diagnostic on full corpora. Points are action × probe family × sampling seed.
The axes measure different outcomes: known-document rediscovery and task relevance.
Repeated seeds share task labels; these points are not independent environment replications.
Exact-title controls unavailable: FiQA · BM25, FiQA · dense.
